title: Pub/Sub Adds Client Telemetry for Publish Operations
summary: The Pub/Sub API now includes new schemas for client-side telemetry, `PubsubClientTelemetry` and `PublishOperation`. These additions provide insights into publish operations, such as hedging attempts and client-side publish start times, to aid in debugging and performance analysis.
details: Two new schemas, `PubsubClientTelemetry` and `PublishOperation`, have been added to the Pub/Sub API. `PubsubClientTelemetry` is designed to carry client-side telemetry data, which will be sent via the `x-goog-pubsub-client-telemetry` header. It includes a `publishOperation` field, referencing the new `PublishOperation` schema. The `PublishOperation` schema provides details like `hedgedAttemptCount` (an integer indicating hedging attempts) and `publishStartTime` (a `google-datetime` string representing the client-side initiation time of the publish call). These new fields offer developers more visibility into the behavior and performance of their Pub/Sub publish calls, particularly for debugging client library interactions and understanding end-to-end latency with hedging.
